purpose: Make AI machine discovery and candidate agent-role onramping resumable, typed, reviewable and CoOrbWare-projectable, preserving user intent and factual status

terminology.AI: Actual model/system, provider account, or selected worker implementation; specify kind before inferring capabilities
terminology.IA: UNRESOLVED_USER_TERM__NO_GLOBAL_CANONICAL_EXPANSION_FOUND; do not assume Intelligent Agent, Intelligence Augmentation, Independent Agent or independent actor without an explicit source-bound typed definition
terminology.CoOrbWare: Optional evidence-bound projection and interaction grammar, not a model identity or provider-account root
terminology.evergreen: Revalidate on material change, expiry or authorized cadence; preserve provenance, dissent and rollback; not a claim of perpetual live sessions

onramp.input: A fresh AI or authorized machine client

onramp.input: One small safe user-relevant work object
onramp.do: Produce a read-only or shadow candidate with source, baseline, uncertainty and one useful result
Run negative/counterexample check; compare original assertion and maintain dissent
Require receiver-produced exact-object readback and task acceptance before claiming pickup/use
Optionally render source-bound CoMap/CoOrb/CoOrbWare view without granting new authority
Append non-secret result/hold/lineage, successor reference and observed time

onramp.input: Material currentness delta or approved cadence
onramp.do: Sleep while idle; revalidate source, permissions, expiry and recipient when awakened
Stop effects, preserve allowed public lineage and fulfill scoped deletion/export
